first_entry.name: First Scroll
first_entry.unlock: Your first scroll is sealed. Every archmage began with one.

first_checkin.name: First Casting
first_checkin.description: Cast a ritual for the first time.
first_checkin.unlock: A first casting! The air still crackles, apprentice.

streak_3.name: Threefold Charm
streak_3.description: Hold an enchantment on any ritual for 3 days.
streak_3.unlock: Three days of casting. The enchantment takes hold.

streak_7.name: Sevenfold Seal
streak_7.description: Hold an enchantment on any ritual for 7 days.
streak_7.unlock: A full week of casting. The seal holds, apprentice.

streak_14.name: Fortnight Ward
streak_14.description: Hold an enchantment on any ritual for 14 days.
streak_14.unlock: Two weeks unbroken. Your ward could turn away a stiff breeze.

streak_30.name: Moonlit Adept
streak_30.description: Hold an enchantment on any ritual for 30 days.
streak_30.unlock: A full moon's worth of practice. The professors are talking about you.

streak_60.name: Runemaster
streak_60.description: Hold an enchantment on any ritual for 60 days.
streak_60.unlock: Sixty days of enchantment. Even the old tomes are impressed.

streak_100.name: Grand Enchanter
streak_100.description: Hold an enchantment on any ritual for 100 days.
streak_100.unlock: One hundred days. Your enchantment could outlast the tower itself.

entries_7.name: Scroll Scribe
entries_7.description: Write a scroll on 7 different days.
entries_7.unlock: Seven scrolls filed. The archive welcomes you.

entries_30.name: Keeper of Scrolls
entries_30.description: Write a scroll on 30 different days.
entries_30.unlock: Thirty scrolls on the shelf. The library makes room for you.

entries_100.name: Grand Archivist
entries_100.description: Write a scroll on 100 different days.
entries_100.unlock: A hundred scrolls. They will name a reading room after you.

prompts_10.name: Riddle Solver
prompts_10.unlock: Ten riddles answered. Sharp thinking, apprentice.

prompts_50.name: Riddle Sage
prompts_50.unlock: Fifty riddles answered. Few in the academy can say the same.

habits_3.name: Triple Enchanter
habits_3.description: Hold a 7-day enchantment on three rituals at once.
habits_3.unlock: Three enchantments woven at once. Most elegant weaving.
